name: 2'-deoxyguanosine riboswitch bound to 2'-deoxyguanosine
source: RCSB PDB 3SKI; Kim JN et al. Nat Chem Biol 2011 doi:10.1038/nchembio.557
notes: DG riboswitch from Mesoplasma florum. Ligand GNG (2'-deoxyguanosine, MW=267). Unique: discriminates 2'-deoxy form from guanosine. 2.30A X-ray.
affinitySource: Kim JN et al. 2011; Kd ~3 uM for 2-deoxyguanosine
affinityNotes: DG riboswitch discriminates 2-deoxyguanosine from guanosine (100-fold selectivity). Novel ligand class in benchmark.
